1	# Nova — Sprint 13 Benchmark: Navigation Consolidation
2	
3	**Target:** InkOS sidebar 31 → 13. Sub-features to in-page tabs. Plan-gated badges + mobile BottomNav.
4	
5	Sources: direct product inspection (Jan 2026). Pixel values from production DOM where noted.
6	
7	---
8	
9	## 1. Top-level nav counts
10	
11	| Product | Items | Pattern |
12	|---|---|---|
13	| **Linear** | **7** (Inbox, My Issues, Views, Projects, Cycles, Roadmaps, Teams) + team subtree | Fixed global rail + team tree. Workspace switcher top. |
14	| **Notion** | **5 fixed** (Search, Home, Inbox, Settings, New page) + user pages | Switcher → 5 actions → collapsible Private/Shared/Teamspaces. |
15	| **Fresha** | **9** (Calendar, Sales, Clients, Catalog, Marketing, Team, Reports, Add-ons, Settings) | Flat, icon + label, studio switcher top. |
16	| **Stripe** | **8** primary (Home, Balances, Transactions, Customers, Product catalog, Payments, Reports, More) + pinned Shortcuts | Collapsible Shortcuts + fixed primary + expandable Products footer (Connect/Billing/Tax/Radar). |
17	| **Square** | **10** (Home, Items, Orders, Customers, Reports, Payments, Employees, Marketing, Online, Settings) | Flat desktop. Mobile = 5-slot BottomNav. |
18	| **Vercel** | **6** (Overview, Projects, Deployments, Analytics, Storage, Settings) per scope | Scope-scoped. Sub-resources on in-page tabs. |
19	
20	**Takeaway:** 13 is top-end. Every winner sits **5–10**. Trim InkOS to 10–11 via grouped section headers.
21	
22	---
23	
24	## 2. In-page tab architecture
25	
26	### Linear issue-list filter pills
27	- Pills (not true tabs) in toolbar under H1. Gap 8px. Padding `6px 10px`, radius 6px.
28	- **13px / 500 / letter-spacing -0.01em**.
29	- Active: bg `hsl(var(--accent))` + 1px border. Inactive: transparent + muted.
30	- Count inline right, `tabular-nums`, muted, ml 6px.
31	- URL: **`?filter=active`** — query string, deep-linkable.
32	
33	### Stripe Payments sub-tabs
34	- Tabs under H1 with 1px bottom border full-width.
35	- `All · Succeeded · Refunded · Uncaptured · Failed · Disputed`.
36	- **Height 40px, padding 0 12px**. Active = **2px solid indigo bottom border**, inactive `#697386`.
37	- Count inline parens: `Succeeded (1,284)`.
38	- URL: **`?status=succeeded`** — survives pagination + date filters.
39	
40	### Segment vs query
41	
42	| Case | Use |
43	|---|---|
44	| Status/filter on same collection (Bookings, Clients) | **Query `?tab=`** — instant, preserves scroll |
45	| Distinct sub-features (Settings → Profile/Team/Billing) | **Segment `/settings/team`** — SEO, bookmarks, code-split |
46	| Dashboard range (Reports → 7d/30d) | **Query `?range=30d`** |
47	
48	Rule: tab changes data shape or needs own route = segment. Pure filter = query.
49	
50	---
51	
52	## 3. Mobile BottomNav — 5 slots
53	
54	| Product | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
55	|---|---|---|---|---|---|
56	| **Fresha Partner** | Calendar | Sales | Clients | Team | More |
57	| **Square POS** | Checkout | Reports | Items | Customers | More |
58	| **Booksy Biz** | Calendar | Clients | **+ Checkout** (FAB) | Menu | More |
59	| **Mindbody** | Schedule | Clients | Sales | Reports | More |
60	
61	**Pattern:** 4 daily operator tasks + "More" full-screen sheet.
62	
63	**"More" sheet:** 100vh modal, header + close X. Rows 56px tall, 24px icon, label 16px/500, chevron right. 12px section headers. Esc/swipe-down dismisses.
64	
65	**Slot metrics:** height **64px iOS / 56px Android M3**. Icon 24×24. Label 11px/500. 4px gap. Safe-area inset respected.
66	
67	**InkOS 5 slots:**
68	1. **Calendar** (daily driver)
69	2. **Clients**
70	3. **+ New Booking** — elevated FAB (Booksy pattern)
71	4. **Inventory**
72	5. **More** → Consent, Commissions, Payroll, Marketing, Reports, Settings, Ink Registry, Admin
73	
74	---
75	
76	## 4. Plan-gated badge pattern
77	
78	| Product | Pattern |
79	|---|---|
80	| **Vercel** | Inline `Pro`/`Ent` pill right-aligned. 10px/600/uppercase, bg tint + accent text, `2px 6px`, radius 4px |
81	| **Linear** | Lock icon + tooltip "Upgrade to Plus to use Cycles" |
82	| **Notion** | `✨ AI` gradient pill `linear-gradient(90deg, #E879F9, #818CF8)` |
83	| **Stripe** | No visual gate — features hidden, click reveals upsell |
84	| **Fresha** | Yellow `PRO` tag |
85	
86	**InkOS inline right-aligned pill, 3 variants:**
87	```
88	[STUDIO] bg electric-purple/10, text electric-purple
89	[PRO]    bg amber-500/15,       text amber-600
90	[ENT]    bg ink-black/10,       text ink-black
91	```
92	Spec: `padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-left: auto;`
93	
94	**Interaction:** click gated item → **no navigation**. Opens upgrade drawer with plan preview + "Upgrade to Studio — $59/mo" CTA. Trial users see all items ungated with `Trial 12d` pill.
95	
96	---
97	
98	## 5. Sidebar density tokens
99	
100	| Token | Value |
101	|---|---|
102	| Width expanded / collapsed | 240–260px / 56–64px |
103	| Item height / padding | 32px / 6–8px × 10–12px |
104	| Icon | 16px (Linear/Notion) / 18px (Stripe) |
105	| Icon→label gap | 8px |
106	| Label | 13px / 500 |
107	| Section header | 11px / uppercase / 600 / letter-spacing 0.04em / muted |
108	| Section gap | 16–20px |
109	| Active | bg fill (Notion) OR 2px left border stripe (Linear) |
110	| Hover | bg `hsl(var(--muted))` 60%, 120ms ease |
111	
112	**InkOS:** 240px/56px, 32px item, 16px icon, 8px gap, 13px/500 label, 16px section gap. **Active = full bg fill** — fits Electric Purple brand better than stripe.
113	
114	---
115	
116	## 6. Three replica notes for Koda
117	
118	### 1. Linear filter pills — `/bookings`, `/clients`, `/inventory`
119	- Row under H1: `gap: 8px; height: 32px`.
120	- Pill: `padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.01em`.
121	- Active: bg `hsl(var(--accent))` + text `hsl(var(--accent-foreground))` + 1px border.
122	- Inactive: transparent, muted text, hover bg `hsl(var(--muted))`.
123	- Count inline: `tabular-nums`, muted, ml 6px.
124	- URL: `?tab=active` via `useSearchParams()` + `router.replace()` — no scroll jump.
125	- Keyboard: Arrow keys move, Enter activates (shadcn `Tabs` + query-sync hook).
126	
127	### 2. Stripe sub-tabs — `/reports/*` and `/settings/*`
128	- `border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border))`, full-width.
129	- Tab: `height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500`.
130	- Active: `color: hsl(var(--foreground))` + `border-bottom: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring))` (Electric Purple).
131	- Inactive: muted, hover foreground.
132	- Inline count: `Succeeded (1,284)` — `tabular-nums`.
133	- **Segment URL** — shared `<TabsLayout>` in `app/(app)/settings/layout.tsx` + `app/(app)/reports/layout.tsx`.
134	
135	### 3. Fresha/Booksy BottomNav
136	- Fixed: `bottom: 0; height: 64px; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
137	- Grid: `grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr)`. Full-slot tap target.
138	- Slot: icon 24×24 top, label 11px/500 bottom, gap 4px, centered.
139	- Active: filled icon + label Electric Purple. Inactive: outline + muted.
140	- **Slot 3 FAB** — `+ New Booking`: 56×56 circle, `translateY(-16px)`, bg Electric Purple, 28px plus, `shadow-soft-md`. Opens `/bookings/new` sheet.
141	- **Slot 5 "More"** → full-screen `<Sheet>` from bottom, 100vh, 8 items in 56px rows + section headers (Manage, Insights, Setup, Admin).
142	- Wrapper `lg:hidden`. Also hide on `/book/[studioSlug]` + `/consent/[token]`.
143	
144	---
145	
146	## 7. Nova's opinionated calls
147	
148	1. **Cut 13 → 10** via grouped sidebar with 11px uppercase headers: `Operate` (Calendar, Bookings, Clients), `Manage` (Inventory, Consent, Commissions, Payroll), `Grow` (Marketing, Reports), `Setup` (Settings, Admin).
149	2. **Query for list filters, segment for sub-features.**
150	3. **Plan-gated badges** inline right-aligned. Click → upgrade drawer, never navigates.
151	4. **Mobile BottomNav with elevated center FAB** for `+ New Booking` — biggest operator UX win (Fresha + Booksy).
152	---
153	
154	## Sources
155	
156	- Linear — [linear.app/method](https://linear.app/method)
157	- Notion — [navigate-workspace](https://www.notion.so/help/guides/navigate-workspace)
158	- Fresha — [fresha.com/for-business](https://www.fresha.com/for-business) + mobile iOS/Android
159	- Stripe — [stripe.com/docs/dashboard](https://stripe.com/docs/dashboard)
160	- Square — [squareup.com/dashboard](https://squareup.com/dashboard) + POS mobile
161	- Vercel — [vercel.com/docs](https://vercel.com/docs/dashboard-features)
162	- Booksy Biz — iOS app (Jan 2026)
163	- Material 3 Nav Bar — [m3.material.io](https://m3.material.io/components/navigation-bar/specs)
164	- iOS HIG Tab Bar — [developer.apple.com](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/tab-bars)
165	
166	Recency: Jan 2026. Free sources only. DOM inspection + M3/HIG spec.

8	## What shipped
9

11	- `components/shared/PlanBadge.tsx` — NEW. Inline pill: solo/studio/pro/enterprise, semantic tokens + explicit dark: variants for studio/enterprise.
12	- `lib/billing/feature-gate.ts` — Exported `PLAN_ORDER` (was module-private, needed by PageTabs).
13	- `components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts` — 31 → 13 items, 8 groups (HOME/SCHEDULE/CLIENTS/TEAM/MONEY/MARKETING/INVENTORY/SETTINGS). Removed 18 sub-items now surfaced as tabs.
14	- `components/app/sidebar/SidebarNavGroup.tsx` — Full-fill active state (`bg-primary/10`), PlanBadge for gated items (show, not hide), section headers 11px uppercase.
15	- `app/(app)/appointments/page.tsx` — Tab host: All / Today / Waitlist. `forceToday` prop added to `AppointmentsPageClient`.
16	- `app/(app)/clients/page.tsx` — Tab host: All Clients / Tags / Consent Forms / AI Design (pro-gated). Server-side data prefetch per active tab.
17	- `app/(app)/artists/page.tsx` — Converted from pure client to server wrapper. Tab host: Roster / Schedules / Guest Artists (pro-gated) / Permissions. Page h1 = "Team".
18	- `app/(app)/artists/ArtistsRosterClient.tsx` — NEW. Extracted roster content from old page.
19	- `app/(app)/artists/SchedulesTabClient.tsx` — NEW. Client wrapper with `ssr:false` dynamic import (required because server components can't use `ssr: false` directly).
20	- `app/(app)/inventory/page.tsx` — Tab host: Stock / Ink Registry.
21	- `next.config.ts` — 8 redirects: old sub-routes → tab params (307 temporary).
22	- `components/shared/BottomNav.tsx` — New slots: Home/Schedule/FAB/Clients/More. `onNew` + `onMoreOpen` props. FAB elevated 56px.
23	- `components/shared/MobileNav.tsx` — PlanBadge on gated items, external open/onOpenChange, useCallback for setOpen stability.
24	- `components/app/sidebar/AppHeader.tsx` — Add `plan` prop, thread to MobileNav, lift `mobileNavOpen` state for BottomNav wiring.
25	
26	---
27	
28	## Key technical decisions
29	
30	**Nav item count:** Kept Vega's 13 items (8 groups) rather than Nova's aggressive 10-11 trim. The 8 groups map cleanly to operator mental models (Home / Schedule / Clients / Team / Money / Marketing / Inventory / Settings). Forcing 10-11 would merge Money+Marketing which damages discoverability.
31	
32	**Active state:** Full bg fill (`bg-primary/10 text-primary`) — dropped left-border stripe. Aligns with Notion pattern, fits Electric Purple brand better than Linear's stripe.
33	
34	**ssr:false in server component:** Next.js 16 Turbopack enforces `ssr:false` only in Client Components. Created `SchedulesTabClient.tsx` as a dedicated client wrapper — clean separation, no hacks.
35	
36	**MobileNav refactor:** Changed `MobileNavItem` from `<Link>` to `<button>` to support gated-item redirect + plan-badge injection. The `useCallback` wrapper on `setOpen` prevents the exhaustive-deps lint warning from the `useEffect` auto-close-on-navigate pattern.
37	
38	**Plan prop threading:** `AppHeader` previously didn't receive `plan`. Added optional prop (default `'solo'`) and passed from `layout.tsx`. Zero breaking change for existing call sites that don't pass it.
